visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A Heap Instead of Searching for the Maximum Repeatedly
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The largest element is found with a loop and removed from an ArrayList again and again. Use a max-heap PriorityQueue. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A heap finds the next largest element in log n steps. Scanning the whole list each time takes n steps per element, which is n squared overall.
